inbodydescription.para: LPD UseCount more then 1 indicates that PS only reset is not called from LPD power down routine. So power down the LPD gracefully which in turn performs PS only reset.
Change default subsystem state to POWERED_OFF as all processors are powered off after force power down LPD.

LPD UseCount value 1 or less indicates that PS only reset is called from LPD power down routine which means that all isolation dependency is taken care in FPD and LPD power down itself and no need to take care in this routine.
